name: La Cinescenie
description: The most spectacular outdoor night show on earth and the defining experience of Puy du Fou — La Cinescenie is a breathtaking open-air theatrical performance staged on a 23-hectare lake with 1,200 volunteer performers, 55 horse riders, 24 fountains, 6,500 costumes, extraordinary pyrotechnics and laser projections witnessed by up to 14,000 spectators at a time. Telling the complete history of the Vendee region from ancient times through the French Revolution and beyond, La Cinescenie runs for approximately 80 minutes and is one of the most emotionally overwhelming spectacles available anywhere in the world. It has been performed every summer since 1978 by the same volunteer community of Les Epesses — a unique cultural phenomenon. Tickets must be booked in advance separately. The show is performed on Friday and Saturday evenings throughout the season.

name: Le Signe du Triomphe
description: The most intense and physically spectacular show at Puy du Fou — Le Signe du Triomphe recreates a Roman gladiatorial arena with breathtaking authenticity. Three hundred performers fill a full-scale amphitheatre as gladiators, lions, chariots and legionaries battle for glory before a crowd of thousands. The sheer scale of the Roman sets, the thundering of chariot wheels on stone, the roar of the crowd and the flawless choreography of the combat sequences make Le Signe du Triomphe one of the finest theatrical productions in Europe. Visitors who have attended Roman history exhibitions or watched gladiatorial films will be completely transported. Seating fills rapidly — arrive 20 minutes early.

name: Le Bal des Oiseaux Fantomes
description: One of the most hauntingly beautiful shows at Puy du Fou and a genuine highlight of any visit — Le Bal des Oiseaux Fantomes is an extraordinary aerial ballet performed by hundreds of trained birds of prey including eagles, vultures, owls, falcons and parrots that swoop, soar and dive in extraordinary formation across the ruins of a medieval castle. The combination of a crumbling chateau backdrop, atmospheric music, theatrical lighting and the sheer wonder of watching magnificent birds flying in coordinated choreography directly over the heads of the audience creates an experience that reduces many visitors to tears. The most unique show at any theme park in the world.

name: Le Secret de la Lance
description: A spectacular medieval jousting tournament staged in a magnificent purpose-built castle courtyard — Le Secret de la Lance features knights in full authentic armour on horseback charging at full gallop with lances, swords, axes and shields in an elaborately choreographed tournament that combines genuine equestrian skill with cinematic theatrical storytelling. The narrative of betrayal, honour and redemption that unfolds between the combat sequences gives the jousting emotional weight and dramatic stakes that make this far more than a simple stunt show. The horsemanship throughout is genuinely world-class.

name: Les Vikings
description: One of Puy du Fou's most dramatic and visually overwhelming shows — Les Vikings stages a full-scale Viking raid on a medieval Norman village with longships sailing across a lake, warriors storming the shore, the village igniting in spectacular controlled fire and an aerial battle between Norse invaders and the village defenders. The combination of water, fire, horses, longships and hundreds of performers creates imagery of genuinely cinematic scale that would be impossible to achieve in any film production environment. The controlled burning of the village set is one of the most breathtaking pyrotechnic sequences in European entertainment.

name: Les Orgues de Feu
description: The most romantic and visually stunning evening show at Puy du Fou and one of the most beautiful theatrical productions in France — Les Orgues de Feu tells the story of a couple separated during the French Revolution through a breathtaking spectacle of fire, water, light and music staged across a lakeside amphitheatre. Fire columns, water curtains, laser projections, orchestral music and the intimate human story combine to create an experience that is simultaneously intimate and overwhelming. Widely regarded as the most emotional show at Puy du Fou and the perfect conclusion to a full day in the Grand Parc.

name: Tristan du Puy du Fou
description: The newest and most technically ambitious show at Puy du Fou — Tristan du Puy du Fou opened in 2025 to universal acclaim and won the Parksmania Award for Best European Creation in its very first season. The show follows Tristan, a young hero of Puy du Fou, who must free King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table from the enchantments of the sorceress Morgane. Combining 40 tonnes of moving set pieces, groundbreaking technical innovations, live performers, horses and extraordinary atmospheric effects in a purpose-built indoor arena, Tristan represents a new benchmark in immersive theatrical entertainment. Already regarded as one of the finest creations in Puy du Fou history.

name: Le Mime et l'Etoile
description: The most intimate and technically astonishing show at Puy du Fou — Le Mime et l'Etoile is a completely silent indoor theatrical experience set in the silent film era of the 1920s that uses extraordinary projection mapping, holographic illusions, practical effects and the performance of a single mime artist to tell a deeply moving story of lost love and the magic of cinema. The technical achievements of this show have been praised by entertainment professionals worldwide and repeatedly described as among the most sophisticated immersive theatrical effects ever created for a theme park environment. An essential experience for visitors who appreciate artistry over spectacle.

name: Le Dernier Panache
description: The most historically rooted and emotionally resonant show at Puy du Fou — Le Dernier Panache tells the story of the Vendean uprising against the French Revolution through the eyes of a real historical figure, combining authentic period costumes, large-scale battle sequences, emotional personal storytelling and the spectacular natural landscape of the Vendee to create a show that moves local French visitors to genuine tears while providing international visitors with a profound window into a little-known but extraordinary chapter of French history.

name: Les Mousquetaires de Richelieu
description: A swashbuckling 17th century adventure show featuring the Three Musketeers and their battles against Cardinal Richelieu — Les Mousquetaires de Richelieu is staged in a magnificent Renaissance-era village square and combines extraordinarily athletic sword fighting, parkour acrobatics, horse riding and theatrical comedy in a show that is simultaneously family-friendly and genuinely impressive for adult visitors. The swordsmanship of the performers is of professional stage combat standard and the show moves at a relentless pace that keeps younger children completely engaged throughout.

name: Le Cirque Romain
description: A thrilling Roman chariot racing show staged in a magnificent purpose-built circus maximus arena — Le Cirque Romain recreates the atmosphere and brutal competition of ancient Roman chariot racing with real horses, authentic chariot designs and competitive racing that produces genuine dramatic tension as drivers fight for position around tight bends at speed. The thundering sound of hooves on stone, the crowd atmosphere and the Roman imperial setting create one of the most viscerally exciting physical spectacles at Puy du Fou.

name: La Cite Medievale
description: A magnificent walk-through medieval village built with extraordinary historical accuracy — La Cite Medievale is a fully realised living medieval town with working craftsmen, blacksmiths, bakers, potters and merchants in authentic period costume going about their daily medieval trades in buildings constructed from authentic materials. Visitors can wander freely through cobbled streets, enter workshops, watch demonstrations and interact with the inhabitants in an immersive experience that creates a genuinely convincing sense of time travel. The detail and quality of the construction surpasses any other medieval recreation in France.

name: Le Village Gaulois
description: A beautifully reconstructed Gallo-Roman village where visitors can walk through the daily life of ancient Gaul — Le Village Gaulois features authentic thatched roundhouses, a Roman temple, a forum, a market and costumed inhabitants recreating the fascinating cultural blend of Celtic Gaul under Roman influence. Particularly popular with families who want to give younger children an accessible and tangible connection to ancient history in a completely safe and relaxed environment away from the intensity of the major shows.

name: La Forteresse Medievale
description: A spectacular walk-through medieval fortress that serves as the atmospheric heart of the Knights Kingdom area of Puy du Fou — La Forteresse Medievale is a full-scale functioning castle with towers, battlements, great hall, dungeons and a working drawbridge that visitors can explore freely. Costumed knights, sentries and castle inhabitants populate the fortress throughout the day creating a completely immersive medieval atmosphere. The views from the battlements across the Vendee countryside are stunning and make for exceptional photography.

name: Grand Carrousel du Roi
description: A magnificent 17th century royal carousel in the heart of the Grand Siecle area of Puy du Fou — the Grand Carrousel du Roi is an extraordinary recreation of the royal carousels that Louis XIV staged at Versailles, featuring costumed riders in full period dress performing equestrian games and pageantry on horseback in a choreographed display of the finest traditions of French classical horsemanship. A perfect introduction to equestrian culture for younger children and a genuinely beautiful spectacle for adult visitors who appreciate horsemanship.
